description: What a Line on security.sarif-import reads: one SARIF file in the workspace, the repository whose results it imports, and the source label it is recorded under; one Line per scanner and repository.

logical_source.description: Source label the SARIF Capture and the derived findings document are recorded under, lowercase: sarif.<scanner> (for example sarif.semgrep). The attention Line's landing Trigger names it, so give each scanner's import its own.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative path of one SARIF 2.1.0 JSON log, at most 1 MiB and 20000 results. Only runs whose versionControlProvenance[0].repositoryUri names the Line's repo are read. A result needs a repository-relative path and a symbol, snippet or primaryLocationLineHash, or it is a location gap, not a finding; a CVE or GHSA result in a manifest is left to the SBOM loop. Only a run with properties cruxible.coverage full, every invocation successful, marks findings fixed. The scanner writes the file; Cruxible does not.

repo.description: The repository the findings belong to, as host/owner/repo in lowercase (for example github.com/acme/shop). It is part of every finding's key and picks which runs of the log are read: a log with no run of this repository imports nothing.

name: security.sarif-import.params
